predecessors.name: Kingdom of Imereti
predecessors.text: Svaneti, 'subject of Kingdom of Imereti' from 1463 (infobox), the Dadeshkeliani holding Upper Svaneti by the 1720s

successors.name: Russian Empire
successors.text: the principality 'abolished and converted into a district' in 1858

capitals.name: Upper Svaneti (no capital named by the source)

ledger.x: 1721: Cliopatria's first shape of the Dadeshkeliani principality of Upper Svaneti.
1721: the Dadeshkeliani principality, as the infobox has it, is 'subject of Kingdom of Imereti' (infobox '1463-1833').
1810, February: the Kingdom of Imereti ceases when Russia annexes it ('Russian Annexation: 20 February 1810'; 'deposed entirely in 1810'), so it can no longer be suzerain.

1833, 26 November: Prince Tsioq' Dadeshkeliani signs a treaty of protectorate with the Russian Empire (Svaneti page); the principality page has 'both branches accepted nominal Russian suzerainty in 1833' and the infobox 'vassal of Russian Empire: 1833-1857'.
1857: the Russian vassalage ends where the infobox puts it ('vassal of Russian Empire: 1833-1857'), the year Baryatinsky 'ordered Svaneti to be subdued by armed force' (contest_start below).
1857: Prince Baryatinsky orders Svaneti subdued by armed force after the Dadeshkeliani feud.
1858: the fighting ends with the abolition of the principality; the infobox gives the end as 1857-1858.
1858: Russia abolishes the Principality of Svaneti and makes it a district.

wars.name: Russian subjugation of Svaneti
wars.outcome: Baryatinsky 'ordered Svaneti to be subdued by armed force' (1857); the principality was 'abolished and converted into a district' in 1858.

certainty.note: Mountain valleys on both sides of the Greater Caucasus with no treaty or survey line; the 1833 protectorate fixed no boundary.
